# The Scala chain, from the Java boot compiler of 2004 to Scala 2.13.18: one stage per line,
#
#   NAME COMMIT PREV MODE  # commit date, release tag
#
# a scala/scala commit built by the compiler of stage PREV (tools/scala-chain turns this
# into nix/scala/chain.nix).  The stages are grouped by the generation they build with:
# the builder script and its settings, nix/scala/generations.nix.
#
# MODE is how locker, the first half of a Scala 2 stage, is built (scala/builders/scala2.sh;
# for Scala 1 stages, scala1.sh):
#   normal  the library first, then the compiler
#   cf      compiler first: for a flag day, when the new library needs the new compiler
#   fresh   no fallback to the previous library, scala.Array from source: for a new library
#           that replaces the old one wholesale (the 2.8 collections, 2009)
#   bridge:FROM:FILE,...  COMMIT's tree with FILEs as of commit FROM
#   bridge-script:FROM:SCRIPT  COMMIT's tree changed by patches/scala/bridges/SCRIPT TREE FROMTREE
# Bridges stand in for the reference compilers ("STARR") of upstream flag days, which were
# built from unpublished intermediate states.
#
# A stage whose PREV is not the line above it continues from an earlier stage: the chain
# climbs side branches to get past flag days that only built there, and some stages are dead
# ends (2.7.7 is one: a release branch).
